Google Trends (imposto de renda): Google Trends is blocking Explore requests from this IP (HTTP 429 'too many requests' / 'unusual traffic' page).

This is a hard, per-IP cooldown, not a transient glitch — the Explore endpoints allow roughly 8-10 fresh browser sessions per hour before blocking. Solutions:
• Wait 30+ minutes before trying again (retrying sooner extends the block)
• Reuse results: cache='disk' answers identical repeat requests without a session
• Use the RSS path for fast, frequent real-time checks

Keyword: 'imposto de renda' | Geo: BR | Timeframe: today 1-m
